newsitem.title: UK: EMU an "adventure" unless criteria met - UK's George.
newsitem.headline: EMU an "adventure" unless criteria met - UK's George.

text.p: Bank of England Governor Eddie George said European monetary union could be a "considerable adventure" if the convergence criteria were not met.

In a speech prepared for delivery at Loughborough University, he said the criteria had been included in the Maastricht Treaty to reduce the tensions that could arise from the irrevocable locking of parities.
"One can debate whether they do in fact sufficiently reduce the risk of tensions emerging between the prospective member countries," George said.

"But if even those criteria are not met, in substance not simply in form, and on a sustainable and not just a one-off basis, then monetary union could be a considerable adventure -- and that of course is the stuff of the economic debate about EMU." -- Richard Murphy, London Newsroom 44 171 542 2774
